name: shelfstock-frontend
_comment_overrides: Two transitive pins that next controls but we carry the risk for. postcss: next pins it exactly and that pin has landed inside a vulnerable range (GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q / GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849, sourceMappingURL path traversal). sharp: next declares ^0.34.3, which cannot reach the patched 0.35.x on its own because a caret does not cross a 0.x minor; <0.35.0 carries the libvips CVEs (CVE-2026-33327/33328/35590/35591). npm's own advice here was to downgrade to next@14, which would reintroduce the far larger set of Next advisories. Drop each override once next depends on a patched version itself.
